site_name: Land to the rear of 72 Kenton Road
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the
original permission, planning permission ref: PL/0954/25 dated 20-06-2025.

<p>All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the
first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the
development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years
from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall
be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority
agrees any variation in writing.</p>

<p>The rooflights of the proposed development shall be of purpose-made obscure glass and thereafter be
retained in that form.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no
window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior
permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall be operated with no more than four (4) employees on site at any
one time, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p>The premises shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other purpose,
including any other purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes)
Order 1987 (as amended) (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking
and re-enacting that order with or without modification).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The scheme
of hard and soft landscape works including:</p><p>1. Proposed planting plans at a scale of not less than 1:100. 2. Schedule of proposed plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes, proposed numbers and densities, all at the time of proposed planting;</p><p>3. A landscape implementation programme;</p><p>4. A landscape maintenance plan covering a period of 5 years from the date of planting;</p><p>5. A proposed hard landscaping plan, including any boundary treatments proposed:</p><p>shall be carried out in accordance with Approval of Details&nbsp;<span style="font-weight: 700;">PL/2529/25</span>&nbsp;dated&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">03-12-2025</span>. The works shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Drawing numbers 0001 REV P1; 1100 REV P1; 1110 REV P1; 1200 REV P1; 1210 REV P1; 3000 REV P1; 3020 REV P1; Design and Access Statement and revised drawings 2000 REV P2, 2010 REV P2, 2020 REV P2, 2030 REV P2, 3010 REV P2, Approval of Details Reserved by Conditions (Conditions 5, Sept 2025)&nbsp;<p class="MsoNormal"><o:p></o:p></p>
